integrity.proof_scope: Unrestricted number of prescribed components of at most five vertices; exhaustive finite base cases with an independent standalone certificate check and mathematical product proof.

scientific_limitations: Exact formulas apply only to a fixed known partition of component vertex supports, all of sizes at most five.
They are not exact dimensions of unrestricted trees, all paths of arbitrary lengths, or variable component-support partitions.
No claim of full priority verification or independent certification is made.
title: A four-point adaptive-shattering threshold for finite path-forest betweenness
